Measures
In this Attachment and Social Anxiety data set, the 3 factors refer to the 3 composites included in the Attachment Anxiety Data. Experiences in Close Relationships (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.9). Social Interaction Anxiety Scale (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.94). and Rosenberg Self-Esteem Scale (Cronbach’s alpha = 0.85).


Data Analysis Strategy
The data for variables SA_1, AA_1, SEst_1, were reverse keyed.
